changes.label: R10 scope and service identity
changes.old:
/**
 * Fingerworker MVP - R9 fixed-frame palm bracing CAD prototype; load rating unverified.
 * R9 changes P02 only: two broad integral compression pads bear against
 * fixed P01 atX-22.75, not the floating yoke, cell or electronics lid.
 * Each7 x13 mm nominal bearing face is atY18..25 orY-25..-18/Z14..27.
 * Two-mm root overlap and explicitR1.2 concave root stocks join the palm.
 * Exact nominal contact needs physical fitting; do not force an interference
 * fit or preload the fixed portal when tightening the palm fasteners.
 * All other bodies, wrist contact, mounts and R8 lid gap remain unchanged.
 * Unload/restrain before removing both M4 bolts and lifting the palm/case
 * module vertically; the contact pads have no hooks or undercuts.
 * R8 changes P02 only: a2 mm flat wrist ledge extends toX-46.1 over P09.
 * The added ledge is joined rigid stock, not a sleeve or an integrated lid.
 * Its undersideZ9.5 retains0.6 mm nominal gap to the lid topZ8.9.
 * P08/P09 and all mounts, openings and R7 mechanism geometry are unchanged.
 * Remove the palm/case unit and detach the case before lifting its lid.
 * USB plug/tool fit, print process, joint strength and500 N remain unqualified.
 * R7: base and rods shorten5 mm; rear shoes adjust equally by0..2 mm.
 * Two M4x10 adjusters use captive DIN562 nuts, OD12 reaction washers
 * and accessible DIN439 jam nuts. Two M2 pins positively retain shoes.
 * Rear cap screws are now explicitly modeled; nominal hardware only.
 * With extra rest advance a, a+p<=2 and u<=30-p-a retain28..30 mm stroke.
 * q=5+a+u dynamically; ISO q=20-p, approach15-p-a. No auto synchronization.
 * Device X envelope176.5 mm includes protruding adjuster ends at a0.
 * Physical locking, setup, print strength and500 N target remain unqualified.
 * R6: former P03 palm contact stock is solid and joined into rigid P02.
 * No separate palm sleeve, core bore, bottom interface gap or retaining tabs.
 * Wrist-facing outer contact curve, palm mounts and electronics are retained.
 * Four P07 TPU return bumpers remain separate and unchanged.
 * Inherited R5 motion and selected81 mm ISO sleeves are retained.
 * R5: dynamic rest and end grip5 mm closer; full30-preload user travel.
 * R7 carriage q=5+a+u; selected81 mm ISO sleeves use q=20-p
 * and user-relative approach u=15-p-a. Rear adjustment requires equal setup.
 * New guided P11 cam shoe is manually set to camTrim-preload.
 * Added pretension, return bosses and print joints need physical checks.
 * This local source is not a validated or strength-qualified release.
 * R4 2026-10-23: SS-01GL2 manufacturer DRAWING clearance reference.
 * Main body, three solder-tab boxes and a conservative lower-lug strip
 * share H09. Lever motion remains approximate; no factory STEP claim.
 * Fixed switch keeps its R4 +4 X / +1 Y / +1.5 Z mm location.
 * R5 replaces the former horizontal M3x8 cam with a P11 shoe and
 * a vertical M3x10 clamp; actual adjustment remains manual.
 * Preserve the R3 palm fit and the R2 sensor-force path and travel limits.
 * Native regeneration and full validation are required before release.
 *
 * X = pull direction, Y = finger-bar width, Z = height above the base.
 * Purchased hardware is modeled at nominal catalogue size. Printed parts are
 * separated bodies so they can be exported and printed individually.
 * SEPARATE BRANCH STUDY 2026-10-19: flat 132 mm frame, 72 mm clear pocket,
 * 84 mm deck, 102 mm spring-axis spacing, 6 mm base, 35 mm nominal sensor-retainer envelope.
 * P02 is detachable on two M4 bolts and positive locating keys. This NEW joint
 * has unqualified stiffness/strength. Palm contact geometry and electronics
 * enclosure are retained; R5 uses81 mm ISO sleeves. Remove both M4 bolts and lift the palm
 * and case module vertically before keeper/cassette assembly or service.
 * Lower forward clamps provide0.75 mm nominal capture-head withdrawal gap.
 * Derived from protected Rev D; this study does not supersede production files.
 * Native regeneration, motion/assembly checks and physical strength validation
 * are required. No tested load capacity or functional equivalence is claimed.
 */
changes.new:
/**
 * Fingerworker MVP - R10 integral frame and solid palm CAD prototype.
 * P01 includes the former P02 rigid palm, its R8 electronics cover and R9
 * portal braces as ONE continuous printed solid. There is no palm sleeve,
 * palm-to-frame joint, M4 palm fastener, locating key or mounting recess.
 * The two forward drops overlap their fixed feet by0.2 mm inZ. The two R9
 * brace ends overlap the FIXED portal by0.2 mm inX. Wrist contact geometry,
 * enclosure M2 pilots and0.6 mm nominal lid gap are retained.
 * No moving yoke, sensor/cassette, keeper or electronics body is fused.
 * The central keeper/adjuster opening is retained. Keeper M3x8 screws now
 * approach from the sensor side; their heads are recessed in P01 atX-17.
 * H15 is a plain-hole plate; H17 nuts sit behind it atX-24.8..-23.
 * A small lower front notch permits unloaded keeper removal by-2 mmX,
 * then+35 mmZ after removing the sensor stack and keeper hardware.
 * Service-access fix: obsolete palm mount feet/ears/drops stop atX-17.
 * H18/H19 cassette retainers can exit alongY through newØ6.4 passages
 * in the outer front rod blocks. Unload and reset sensor preload to0 first.
 * The former detachable-palm lift-off service route no longer exists.
 *
 * Foreign-part collision audits run on the separate construction regions
 * BEFORE the final union. Their geometry includes the positive overlaps;
 * only the internal Palm/Base pair is omitted as an intended single solid.
 * This preserves region-specific contact policies and avoids qCreatedBy
 * tracing the whole fused frame as "palm" during hand/electronics checks.
 * The final union has an explicit exactly-one-solid assertion.
 *
 * Inherited R7/R9 mechanism dimensions and manual setup are unchanged:
 * rear advance a and sensor preload p require a>=0,p>=0,a+p<=2;
 * dynamic user travel u obeys0<=u<=30-p-a and absolute q=5+a+u.
 * Selected81 mm ISO sleeves use q=20-p and approach15-p-a.
 * Two M4x10 rear adjusters, captive DIN562 nuts, OD12 reaction washers,
 * DIN439 jam nuts and two M2 shoe-retaining pins remain hardware.
 * P07 return bumpers remain separate; no flexible palm sleeve is required.
 * H09 is an Omron SS-01GL2 DRAWING reference, not manufacturer STEP.
 * Native regeneration, assembly/service and printability checks are required.
 * This nominal CAD prototype has no tested load rating or500 N qualification.
 *
 * X=pull direction, Y=finger-bar width, Z=height above the base.
 * Flat132 envelope:132 mm width,72 mm clear pocket,84 mm deck,
 * 102 mm spring-axis spacing,6 mm nominal floor,35 mm device height.
 * Frozen parent:R9 source SHA16972ba9341f4cdf763a5570dad82a4fbd601f0935d0a7657be85813f97ff2b1.
 */
